mapper.select: SELECT a.asgn_id AS "assignmentId",d.dev_id AS "developerId",d.dev_nm AS "name",d.mng_no AS "managementNumber", d.job_cd AS "developerJob",d.sub_job_cd AS "subJobCode",d.grade_cd AS "gradeCode",d.emp_type_cd AS "employeeTypeCode", p.proj_id AS "projectId",p.proj_nm AS "projectName",a.job_cd AS "jobCode",a.input_end_dt AS "withdrawalDate", a.ext_cnt::int AS "extensionCount",(a.early_wthdr_yn='Y') AS "earlyWithdrawal",a.ext_psbl_cd AS "extensionPossibility", p.proj_stat_cd AS "projectStatus",d.use_yn AS "developerUse",d.drct_cls_cd AS "directClass",d.work_stat_cd AS "workStatus", d.jncmp_dt AS "joinDate",d.retire_dt AS "retireDate",p.cust_clnt_id AS "customerId" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id WHERE a.asgn_stat_cd!='CNCL' AND ((a.input_end_dt >= make_date(#{year},1,1) AND a.input_end_dt < make_date(#{year}+1,1,1)) OR (a.input_end_dt >= #{today} AND a.input_end_dt <= #{soonEnd})) ORDER BY a.input_end_dt,d.mng_no,a.asgn_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id='JOB' AND code=#{job} AND use_yn='Y' AND del_yn='N')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'CONFIRMED' AS "kind",a.asgn_id AS "assignmentId",NULL::text AS "tentativeAssignmentId", a.proj_id AS "projectId",NULL::text AS "opportunityId",p.proj_nm AS "name",a.input_bgn_dt AS "startDate", NULL::text AS "startMonth" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id WHERE a.dev_id=#{developerId} AND a.asgn_id!=#{assignmentId} AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND p.proj_stat_cd!='LOSE' AND a.input_bgn_dt > #{withdrawalDate} UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN t.tent_stat_cd='CNVT' THEN 'CANDIDATE' ELSE 'TENTATIVE' END,NULL::text,t.tent_id::text, o.proj_id,o.opp_id,CASE WHEN t.tent_stat_cd='CNVT' THEN COALESCE(p.proj_nm,o.opp_nm) ELSE o.opp_nm END, CASE WHEN t.tent_stat_cd='CNVT' THEN p.ctrt_bgn_dt ELSE NULL::date END, to_char(to_date(t.bgn_ym,'YYYYMM'),'YYYY-MM') FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn t JOIN tb_sl_opp o ON o.opp_id=t.opp_id LEFT JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=o.proj_id WHERE t.dev_id=#{developerId} AND ((t.tent_stat_cd='ACT' AND o.opp_stat_cd='ING') OR t.tent_stat_cd='CNVT')
) n ORDER BY CASE "kind" WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN 0 WHEN 'CANDIDATE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, COALESCE("startDate",to_date("startMonth",'YYYY-MM')),"assignmentId" NULLS LAST,"tentativeAssignmentId" NULLS LAST

SELECT n.opp_id AS "opportunityId",n.need_sn::int AS "needSn",n.job_cd AS "jobCode",n.grade_cd AS "gradeCode", to_char(to_date(n.bgn_ym,'YYYYMM'),'YYYY-MM') AS "startMonth",n.prd_mcnt::int AS "months", (n.need_cnt-(SELECT count(*) FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn t WHERE t.opp_id=n.opp_id AND t.need_sn=n.need_sn AND t.tent_stat_cd='ACT' AND t.dev_id!=#{developerId}))::int AS "remainingCount", o.ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",j.add_val1 AS "relatedJobs",o.cust_clnt_id AS "customerId",o.win_prbl_rt AS "probability" FROM tb_sl_opp_need n JOIN tb_sl_opp o ON o.opp_id=n.opp_id JOIN tb_sy_code j ON j.code_grp_id='JOB' AND j.code=n.job_cd AND j.use_yn='Y' AND j.del_yn='N' WHERE o.opp_stat_cd='ING' ORDER BY n.opp_id,n.need_sn
SELECT dev_id AS "developerId",bgn_dt AS "startDate",end_dt AS "endDate" FROM tb_hr_dev_stat WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} AND work_stat_cd='LEAVE' ORDER BY bgn_dt,stat_sn
SELECT code_nm FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id='JOB' AND code=#{job} AND del_yn='N'
